draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.00, the 138th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 15th of 23 at DT. He lasted until pick 179, well after his grade rank (138th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2022) ranked 1st in sacks among the 23 DTs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Green Bay Packers. 50 career games and 7 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 3 AV in 2025 against a career-best 3 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: season snap share 55.2% (77th percentile). Weak spots: missed tackle rate 9.7% (23rd percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 interior lineman who played: 6 pressures against a median of 4, above the norm.
